title: Stream Movies on Your Car Screen with iPhone #shorts
description:
Stream movies, YouTube and Google Maps on your car screen with iPhone screen mirroring, a big-screen upgrade for CarPlay drivers. No cables, no smart TV, just your phone and the display in your dashboard. Turn every road trip into a movie night.

Car screen tips for drivers in the USA: Phoenix, Denver, Boston, San Diego.
Search Car Widgets: AutoDash on the App Store.

#carplay #screenmirroring #carscreen
